"''Fire.|[[Lieutenant]] [[Milon Lenwith]] and [[Captain]] [[Chesille Sabrond]]|}} The '''''Derriphan''''' was a [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer]] of the [[Final Order]] that was the first of the new [[Starship|ships]] to launch from [[Exegol]]. It [[Destruction of Kijimi|destroyed]] the [[planet]] [[Kijimi]]. The name came from the [[Ur-Kittât|Sith]] word for "devourer." ==History== {{Quote|Send a ship to a world they know. Let it burn.|Darth Sidious gives the order for Kijimi to be destroyed|}} [[File:DerriphanFiresAtKijimi-TROS.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Derriphan'' fires its axial superlaser at Kijimi.]] The ''Derriphan'' was one of the 1,080 [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers]] that formed the [[Final Order]] of [[Darth Sidious]]. On the orders of Sidious, the ''Derriphan'' was the first [[Star Destroyer]] to successfully launch from [[Exegol]] where the remainder of the [[fleet]] was stationed, their numbers too expansive to all leave the [[planet]] simultaneously without being guided out by a [[navigational beacon]]. Sidious later ordered [[Allegiant General]] [[Enric Pryde]] to choose a planet with connections with the [[Resistance]] to destroy as a show of force. The frigid world of [[Kijimi]] was chosen, and once General Pryde ordered the [[Kijimi garrison|garrison]] to activate [[Protocol 13]], the ''Derriphan'' used its [[axial superlaser]] to [[Destruction of Kijimi|obliterate]] the entire planet. After this, the Star Destroyer fled back to Exegol to join the fleet. As the Sith fleet prepared to exit the planet, the [[Resistance]], and eventually the [[Citizens' Fleet]], [[Battle of Exegol|came and destroyed]] all of the Sith Star Destroyers, including the ''Derriphan'' and its crew. {{Ship-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The ''Derriphan'' first appeared in [[canon]] in the [[2019]] [[Star Wars saga]] film {{Film|IX}}. It was identified in the corresponding [[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary|visual dictionary]]. In the "[[A Certain Point of View (department)|A Certain Point of View]]" department in [[Star Wars Insider 213|''Star Wars Insider'' 213]], an image of the ''Derriphan'' is erroneously used to depict the [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']].{{InsiderCite|213|A Certain Point of View}} In [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], "Derriphan" was a type of [[Derriphan (creature)|dark side creature]].''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]'' ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Derriphan}} *{{Film|IX}} {{1st}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} {{Hologram}} *[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|''Derriphan''}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Final Order and the Battle of Exegol}} *{{InsiderCite|220|A Certain Point of View}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles (second edition)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'' second edition]] ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |cs=Derriphan |el=Ντέριφαν |es=Derriphan |fr=Derriphan |pl=Derriphan (typu Xyston) |tr=Derriphan }} [[Category:Starships of the Sith Eternal]] [[Category:Xyston-class Star Destroyers]]
